{{Quote|There were no survivors on Devaron. Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan.|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], reporting on the fate of Halsey|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
'''Halsey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Alongside his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], Halsey participated in the Republic's [[Devaron massacre/Legends|defense]] of the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. Though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]] were initially successful in fighting off the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|pupil]] of Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], turned the tide of the battle and cut through the Republic defenders. Halsey moved to confront Opress, but his combat skills were insufficient in dealing with the threat, and both he and Knox were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Zabrak [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. The Jedi's bodies were later recovered and [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Separatist [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Saboteur/Legends|agents]] attempted to sabotage his [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] at the Temple, but Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] prevented them from turning his coffin into a [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas bomb.

==Biography==
===Jedi Master===
{{Quote|The Temple has been taken.''"<br />"''And the Jedi?''"<br />"''Dead.|Savage Opress and Dooku, following Halsey's death|<ref name="Monster" />}}
Halsey was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]]<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" /> a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Monster" /> He took the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="Clone Card: Knox">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_knox.jpg|text=Clone Card: Knox}}</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Monster Date" /> Halsey was present in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] alongside several other members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] when the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] informed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of his [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|successful capture]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

[[File:Halsey-Monster.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Halsey fights beside his Padawan, Knox.]]
Halsey and his apprentice were later stationed at the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]], a Republic outpost on the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" /> During their [[Time/Legends|time]] on Devaron, the Temple came under [[Devaron massacre/Legends|attack]] by a force of Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Halsey and Knox led the defense of the outpost, assisted by [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF troopers]]<ref name="Monster" /> under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] "[[Trauma/Legends|Trauma]]."<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" /> In the midst of the battle, the Separatists were joined by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|apprentice]] to Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] proceeded to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all who stood in his way&mdash;[[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] alike&mdash;before he reached the Temple's entrance. Halsey moved to confront Opress, who managed to avoid several strikes from the Roonan's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] before disarming the Jedi. Though he proceeded to engage the assassin in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], Halsey was repeatedly struck by [[Savage's spear/Legends|Opress's pike]] and knocked to the ground, where he was stabbed by his opponent and killed. Knox attempted to avenge his Master's death, but he too fell to Opress, who reported his victory to Dooku.<ref name="Monster" />

===Funeral===
{{Quote|Now we may continue Master Halsey's memorial service. Being used as a pawn to slay his fellows would have grieved him terribly&hellip; Perhaps his soul will rest easier, Obi-Wan&mdash;knowing you prevented that!|Mace Windu, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCWComicCite|6.38|Sabotage (comic story)}}</ref>}}
[[File:FuneralOfHalsey-TCWUK638.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Master Yoda prepares to cremate Halsey's body.]]
The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] were later dispatched to Devaron to search for survivors of the engagement. Finding none, they recovered the corpses of Halsey and Knox and returned them to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant. The Jedi High Council concluded that the deaths of the Roonan Jedi and his apprentice were a sign of a new threat to the Republic; their suspicion was confirmed when security footage of the massacre, including Halsey's death, was recovered.<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> His body was transferred to a coffin by a [[Unidentified Coruscant funeral firm|Coruscant funeral firm]] so that it could be [[Cremation/Legends|cremated]] at the Jedi Temple. However, a trio of [[Unidentified Weequay agent 1|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 2|Weequay]] [[Unidentified Weequay agent 3|agents]], posing as workers at the firm, attempted to sabotage his [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] to kill the Jedi who would be attending the service. Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] learned of the plot and arrived on the Temple steps just as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was about to ignite Halsey's funeral pyre. Kenobi removed a [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas bomb that the Separatists had inserted into the coffin, saving the other attendees&mdash;Masters [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;from the threat.<ref name="Sabotage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Stay back!|Halsey, to Knox, prior to their deaths|<ref name="Monster" />}}
[[File:OpressHalsey-Devaron.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Halsey, deprived of his lightsaber, faces off against Opress.]]
Halsey was an agile and wise<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" /> Jedi Master,<ref name="Witches of the Mist" /> and he was admired by his apprentice, Knox.<ref name="Clone Card: Knox" /> When confronted by Savage Opress, he instructed his Padawan to stay back as he attempted to defeat his opponent on his own.<ref name="Monster" /> Following his death, Halsey was remembered by his peers as one of the most valiant members of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Sabotage" /> The Jedi stood 1.99 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and blue-gray skin.<ref name="Clone Card: Halsey" />

==Powers and abilities==
Skilled with both a lightsaber and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Halsey was capable of redirecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts with his lightsaber and [[Force jump/Legends|jumping high using the Force]]. The Roonan was also knowledgeable in unarmed combat, though his talents were not sufficient to defeat Savage Opress.<ref name="Monster" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Roonan Jedi Halsey first appeared as a background character in "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," the ninth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. He was identified by name in the accompanying episode guide.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> Halsey later made an appearance in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Monster]]," in which he was voiced by [[Corey Burton]]. Halsey went through several name changes during development; concept art identified him as "Jayfo Ong" before he was renamed to "Tukker Val Loo" and then "Lev'loa" before his final name was determined. The Roonan's character model was constructed using the preexisting body of Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], albeit retextured.<ref name="Monster guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref>
